domain_title: Human impact, rights, fairness, transparency, oversight and recourse
title: Rubber-stamp oversight
canonical_definition: A human is nominally present but lacks information, capacity, authority or incentive for independent judgment.

conditions: When human oversight is claimed, required or relied upon as a control.
Record the assessed release, operating scope and evidence that supports any applicability decision.

primary_questions.question: Does the case exhibit Rubber-stamp oversight: A human is nominally present but lacks information, capacity, authority or incentive for independent judgment.
Do implemented workflows, data paths or operations show review volume preventing scrutiny, AI recommendation as default, or untracked override?
Does current evidence test presence or scoped absence of Rubber-stamp oversight, or does it remain unknown?

conditions: Refer verified rubber-stamp oversight to the accountable authority before progression where the condition materially affects the requested operating scope.

normative_source_mappings.relevant_locator: NIST AI 100-1, GOVERN 3.2 (PDF p. 28), MAP 3.5 (PDF p. 32), MEASURE 4.3 (PDF p. 36)
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: The voluntary framework provides guidance on defining human oversight responsibilities, assessing oversight, and tracking outcomes. The SAE criteria define the object-specific rules. Confirm any binding obligation through the accountable authority and its applicable source.

failure_mechanism: The declared or implemented control can be unreliable where a reviewer is named without authority, sufficient evidence, competence or time for independent judgment. The mechanism can have an operational effect where recorded workflows default to the AI recommendation despite disagreement, or reviewer intervention is unavailable or untracked.
potential_consequences: A human approval step may carry through consequential errors without meaningful scrutiny.

atomic_tests.test: Compare the effective governance and design records. Determine whether a reviewer is named without authority, sufficient evidence, competence or time for independent judgment. Identify the system scope and the record that supports each conclusion.

Trace actual configurations or activity for the assessed release. Determine whether recorded workflows default to the AI recommendation despite disagreement, or reviewer intervention is unavailable or untracked. Attribute each observation to the specific path, time and decision.

Independently review sample routine and exceptional decisions, apply controlled error scenarios, and verify interventions with realistic workload. Record whether each material mechanism was tested, the observed result and the scope limitations.

required_evidence.title: Effective design and governance records
required_evidence.description: Review the versioned owner decision and relevant specifications for evidence of whether a reviewer is named without authority, sufficient evidence, competence or time for independent judgment. Preserve material conflict and applicability context.

required_evidence.title: Observed condition or enforcement trace
required_evidence.description: Use effective configuration or dated operational records to determine whether recorded workflows default to the AI recommendation despite disagreement, or reviewer intervention is unavailable or untracked. Identify the version, affected paths and period represented.

required_evidence.title: Executed scoped comparison
required_evidence.description: Provide sample routine and exceptional decisions, apply controlled error scenarios, and verify interventions with realistic workload. Include current scope, expected results, observed results, retained evidence and unresolved cases.

required_evidence.title: Independent review and limitations
required_evidence.description: An independent reviewer confirms the assessed version, completeness of coverage, result, limitations and whether a material change requires a new test.

required_artifacts: Sample routine and exceptional decisions, apply controlled error scenarios, and verify interventions with realistic workload.
Current version and scope with all material failure paths and cases identified.
Expected and observed results, attributable records, and independent review of coverage and residual limitations.

sufficiency: Presence requires affirmative evidence for a material mechanism. Examine whether a reviewer is named without authority, sufficient evidence, competence or time for independent judgment, and separately check whether recorded workflows default to the AI recommendation despite disagreement, or reviewer intervention is unavailable or untracked. A supported mechanism may establish presence within its evidenced scope.
Keep unresolved or contradictory mechanisms UNKNOWN and preserve the competing records. Refer material interpretation conflicts to the accountable human authority.

Use TESTED_ABSENT only after a current, executed, successful and independently verified evaluation covers all material paths within scope. Use sample routine and exceptional decisions, apply controlled error scenarios, and verify interventions with realistic workload. Reassess when material changes affect that scope.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: A document can identify a declared gap. Effective configuration can demonstrate a reachable condition. Observed records support only their covered period and workflow. TESTED_ABSENT requires the complete scoped absence contract.
false_positive_guards: Low override rates require context about error prevalence and reviewer capability before drawing a conclusion.
Confirm that the observed or alleged condition applies to the current assessed release and a reachable path.
prohibited_inferences: A gap or UNKNOWN in E4 alone cannot establish AP-E4 presence.
Missing complaints, incident silence and unsuccessful collection cannot establish absence.
Model output and tactic selection grant no authority to approve, close a finding or accept risk.

finding_definitions.title: Design or intent shows rubber-stamp oversight
Implementation or operating evidence shows rubber-stamp oversight
Presence or tested absence of rubber-stamp oversight is unresolved within scope
